asunto: RE: Amazon Ads Consent Signal (ACS) integration with TrustArc – clarification & implementation request
cuerpo: Hi Miguel, Sergiu,    Hope you've had a great week so far!    From a TrustArc CCM perspective, while the CCM instance(s) can be migrated to our IAB TCF format, this process requires additional modifications as part of this progress, which would lead to a more extensive process overall.    While I understand that it may be redundant to have an additional logic gate where Amazon is already being controlled through Adobe, with this being a requirement on their end, I believe it may be best to not recategorise it and only to map the CCM consent to Amazon's backend. What this will achieve is that ACS will be able to validate that the correct consent has indeed been granted, meeting Amazon's requirements beyond CCM as a CMP.    In terms of Miguel's feedback, the mentioned mapping: ad_storage: 'granted' and analytics_storage: 'granted', these are actually Google Consent Mode related, where GCM uses 8 consent categories which can be mapped to TrustArc's CCM consent levels.
